Watts made this hymn from Psalm 24, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

1The earth is the LORD’s, and the fullness thereof, the world and all who dwell therein. 2For He has founded it upon the seas and established it upon the waters. 3Who may ascend the hill of the LORD? Who may stand in His holy place? 4He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not lift up his soul to an idol or swear deceitfully. … 6 more verses PSALM 24 · ITS FIRST VERSES · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 24
This spacious earth is all the Lord's, And men, and worms, and beasts, and birds: He rais'd the building on the seas, And gave it for their dwelling-place. STANZA I
